g.text: MAKE is not a platform we build for you. It is running now.
The only new work is connecting it to your stack.
Last round the technology read as complex, unbuilt, slow to pay back, and heavy on your team. This section answers those four concerns in order, and it flags openly what we have not
NOT TO SCALE · SEQUENCE ONLY · NO DATES
the part they heard, and the part that is not real
a long build sits between signing and any benefit, and most of the effort inside it looks like theirs. That is the version of the story we are replacing.
Your DAM, your review and approval,
your channel feeds. Scoped in discovery.
Modular production from day one. Second markets order from what already exists rather than re‑briefing.
MAKE: already built, already running on our work
The only new work is the dashed segment.
Everything drawn solid is running today. Nothing in this section asks you to wait for a platform to be finished.
THE FOUR CONCERNS FROM THE LAST ROUND, AND WHERE EACH ONE IS ANSWERED
Too many parts to understand or adopt.
It reads as a platform project, not a service.
Payback sits beyond the horizon they care about.
“That is a lot of effort for us.”
Named directly: reverse engineering the DAM.
HOW TO READ EVERY DIAGRAM IN THIS SECTION
Built and in use on our work now
Direction only. No dates in this deck.
Your DAM, your tools, your team
TECHNOLOGY SECTION · STORYBOARD FOR NARRATIVE AGREEMENT
